name: Hotel President Wilson
insider_take: This lakefront luxury icon holds the Guinness World Record for the world's most expensive hotel suite - the Royal Penthouse Suite at $80,000 per night.
whats_special: The Royal Penthouse Suite spans the entire 8th floor with panoramic Lake Geneva views, bulletproof windows, and a private elevator. The hotel sits directly on the shores of Lake Geneva with the famous Jet d'Eau fountain just steps away. As a Luxury Collection property, it offers exclusive Marriott STARS benefits including room upgrades and VIP recognition.
pro_tip: Book a lake-view room on higher floors for stunning vistas of Mont Blanc and the Alps. The hotel's position offers some of Geneva's best sunset views over the water.
dont_miss: Take a stroll along the lakefront promenade to the iconic Jet d'Eau, one of the world's tallest fountains shooting water 140 meters high. The nearby Flower Clock and English Garden are perfect for morning walks, while the luxury shopping district on Rue du Rhône is just minutes away.
pros: Prime lakefront location with stunning Lake Geneva and Mont Blanc views
Ultra-luxurious Presidential Suite among world's most expensive hotel suites
Michelin-starred dining and exceptional culinary experiences
Exclusive Marriott STARS program benefits and personalized service
World-class spa and wellness facilities with lake views
cons: Ultra-luxury pricing reflects premium Geneva location
Formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers
